Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The communication is really good. You get send some papers you need to fill out and that is it.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You can always get a hold of someone over email.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I could pick anything I wanted but had to change a couple because the modules were overlapping

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Choose a max of 3-4 third year courses and the first or second year courses. Look at the exam form because you can end up having to write 10 essays in 5 days (I did)

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: really easy. The drinking culture is a bit different but you get used to it

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: just talk to anyone they will love to have a conversation

questions.answer: drinking, smoking and drugs

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: They are so open and outgoing

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: enjoy it! the people are amazing. Be open, start random conversations and join societies
